en: An old sepia-toned postcard designed over the front page of a Portuguese newspaper titled "Novidades" dated Friday, 4 April 1902. In the center, a torn-paper effect reveals a photograph of a waterfront fortress tower with battlements, identified below as "Lisboa. Torre de Belem." The photo is overprinted with a large circular postal cancellation. There are multiple postal marks and extensive handwritten script in ink addressing the card to a person in Spain. The overall style is antique and journal-like.
